MATCH (a:Node)-[r:Wire]->(b:Node) WHERE ((a.t = 1 AND b.t = 1) OR (a.t = 2 AND b.t = 2)) AND r.t = 1 
WITH collect(DISTINCT r) AS allEdges 
WITH reduce( acc = {matchedEdges: [], matchedNodes: []}, e IN allEdges | CASE WHEN collections.contains(acc.matchedNodes, startNode(e)) OR collections.contains(acc.matchedNodes, endNode(e)) THEN acc ELSE { matchedEdges: acc.matchedEdges + e, matchedNodes: acc.matchedNodes + [startNode(e), endNode(e)] } END ) AS result 
WITH result.matchedEdges AS matchedEdges 

UNWIND matchedEdges AS e
WITH startNode(e) AS u, endNode(e) AS v, e, matchedEdges
ORDER BY u.id, v.id
LIMIT 1
CREATE (merged:Node { id: u.id, qubit: coalesce(u.qubit, -1), row: coalesce(u.row, -1), phase: coalesce(u.phase, 0.0) + coalesce(v.phase, 0.0), t: u.t, graph_id: u.graph_id })
WITH matchedEdges, collect({u: u, v: v, merged: merged, e: e}) AS merges

WITH merges, 
     reduce(lst = [], m IN merges | lst + [{old: id(m.u), new: id(m.merged)}, {old: id(m.v), new: id(m.merged)}]) AS reps,
     reduce(lste = [], m IN merges | lste + [id(m.e)]) AS e_ids

UNWIND merges AS m
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:Wire]-() WHERE id(n) IN [id(m.u), id(m.v)] AND NOT id(r) IN e_ids
WITH DISTINCT r, reps, merges

WITH r, reps, merges, startNode(r) AS sn, endNode(r) AS en
WITH r, reps, merges,
     [rep IN reps WHERE rep.old = id(sn) | rep.new] AS sn_rep,
     [rep IN reps WHERE rep.old = id(en) | rep.new] AS en_rep
WHERE r IS NOT NULL

WITH r, merges,
     CASE WHEN size(sn_rep) > 0 THEN sn_rep[0] ELSE id(startNode(r)) END AS final_sn_id,
     CASE WHEN size(en_rep) > 0 THEN en_rep[0] ELSE id(endNode(r)) END AS final_en_id

MATCH (n1:Node) WHERE id(n1) = final_sn_id
MATCH (n2:Node) WHERE id(n2) = final_en_id
CREATE (n1)-[:Wire {t: r.t, graph_id: r.graph_id}]->(n2)

WITH DISTINCT merges
UNWIND merges AS m
DETACH DELETE m.u, m.v
WITH DISTINCT merges
RETURN size(merges) AS merged

CALL {
// For each pattern
MATCH (a)
WHERE a.pattern_id IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT a.pattern_id AS pid, a.graph_id AS graph_id

// Collect nodes in A and B for this pattern
MATCH (a1 {pattern_id: pid, t: 1})
WITH pid, collect(a1) AS A, graph_id
MATCH (b1 {pattern_id: pid, t: 2})
WITH pid, A, collect(b1) AS B, graph_id
WHERE size(A) + size(B) > 2

// Create new supernodes
CREATE (newA:Node {t: 2, pattern_id: pid, graph_id: graph_id})
CREATE (newB:Node {t: 1, pattern_id: pid, graph_id: graph_id})

// Reconnect edges to the new nodes
WITH A, B, pid, newA, newB
UNWIND A AS oldA
MATCH (oldA)-[r]-(other)
WHERE other.pattern_id IS NULL
CREATE (newA)-[r2:Wire]->(other)
SET r2 += properties(r)
WITH pid, B, newA, newB, collect(oldA) AS oldANodes

UNWIND B AS oldB
MATCH (oldB)-[r]-(other)
WHERE other.pattern_id IS NULL
CREATE (newB)-[r2:Wire]->(other)
SET r2 += properties(r)
WITH pid, newA, newB, oldANodes, collect(oldB) AS oldBNodes

// Connect the new supernodes
CREATE (newA)-[:Wire {t: 1, graph_id: newA.graph_id}]->(newB)

// Delete the old nodes
FOREACH (n IN oldANodes + oldBNodes | DETACH DELETE n)
RETURN pid, newA, newB
}
CALL {
  MATCH (n)
  REMOVE n.pattern_id
}
RETURN pid, newA, newB;

MATCH path = (start)-[:Wire*2..6]-(end)
WHERE 
  // Even length path
  size(relationships(path)) % 2 = 0
  // All edges are unmarked Hadamard edges
  AND ALL(edge IN relationships(path) WHERE edge.t = 2 AND edge.pattern_id IS NULL)
  // All intermediate nodes are unmarked identity Z-spiders
  AND ALL(node IN nodes(path)[1..-1] 
          WHERE node.t = 1 
          AND node.phase % 2 = 0 
          AND degree(node) = 2 
          AND node.pattern_id IS NULL)
  // Only process unmarked start/end nodes
  AND start.pattern_id IS NULL 
  AND end.pattern_id IS NULL

// Order by path length (longest first) and node IDs for consistency
WITH path, nodes(path) as path_nodes, relationships(path) as path_edges
ORDER BY length(path) DESC, id(nodes(path)[0]), id(nodes(path)[-1])
LIMIT 1

// Mark this pattern with unique ID
WITH path_nodes, path_edges, randomUUID() as pattern_id

// Mark all edges in the path
UNWIND path_edges AS edge
SET edge.pattern_id = pattern_id

// Mark all intermediate nodes in the path
WITH path_nodes[1..-1] as intermediate_nodes, pattern_id, path_edges
UNWIND intermediate_nodes AS node
SET node.pattern_id = pattern_id

RETURN DISTINCT pattern_id, length(path_edges) as path_length

// Find all marked patterns
MATCH (s)
WHERE s.pattern_id IS NOT NULL

// Reconstruct the full path for each pattern
WITH DISTINCT s.pattern_id AS pattern_id
MATCH path = (start)-[:Wire*2..6]-(end)
WHERE ALL(edge IN relationships(path) WHERE edge.pattern_id = pattern_id)
AND start.pattern_id IS NULL AND end.pattern_id IS NULL AND id(start) < id(end)

WITH start, end, pattern_id,
      [node IN nodes(path)[1..-1] WHERE node.pattern_id = pattern_id] as nodes_to_delete

// Create direct connection
WITH start, end, nodes_to_delete, pattern_id
ORDER BY start.id, end.id
LIMIT 1
CREATE (start)-[newWire:Wire {t: 1}]->(end)

// Delete the nodes with the corresponding Hadamard edges
WITH nodes_to_delete, pattern_id
UNWIND nodes_to_delete AS node
DETACH DELETE node

// Return something to ensure changes were made
WITH pattern_id
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT pattern_id) as patterns_processed

MATCH (b:Node) WHERE b.phase % 2 = 0 AND b.t = 1 AND degree(b) = 2 MATCH (v1)-[e1:Wire]-(b)-[e2:Wire]-(v2) WHERE id(v1) < id(v2) AND NOT (v1.t = 0 AND v2.t = 0) AND NOT (v1.t = 1 AND v1.phase % 2 = 0 AND degree(v1) = 2 AND id(v1) < id(b)) AND NOT (v2.t = 1 AND v2.phase % 2 = 0 AND degree(v2) = 2 AND id(v2) < id(b)) WITH b, v1, v2, e1, e2 ORDER BY b.id, v1.id, v2.id LIMIT 1 WITH b, v1, v2, e1, e2, CASE WHEN (e1.t + e2.t) % 2 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS new_type CREATE (v1)-[:Wire {t: new_type, graph_id: coalesce(b.graph_id, v1.graph_id)}]->(v2) WITH DISTINCT b WITH collect(b) AS deleted FOREACH(node IN deleted | DETACH DELETE node) RETURN CASE WHEN size(deleted) > 0 THEN true ELSE null END AS removed_identities;

// Find and rewrite local complementation patterns (green spider with ±0.5 phase and all-green Hadamard neighbors)
MATCH (center:Node)
WHERE center.t = 1
  AND (center.phase = 0.5 OR center.phase = -0.5)

// Collect all neighbors
MATCH (center)-[w:Wire {t:2}]-(nbr:Node {t:1})
WITH center, COLLECT(DISTINCT nbr) AS neighbors, COLLECT(w) AS neighbor_edges
WHERE size(neighbors) > 0 
  AND ALL(neigh IN neighbors WHERE neigh.t = 1)
  AND ALL(w in neighbor_edges WHERE w.t = 2)

// Sort by some deterministic criteria to pick one center per query execution
WITH center, neighbors
ORDER BY center.id
LIMIT 1

// Complement: toggle all edges between neighbor pairs
WITH center, neighbors, range(0, size(neighbors)-2) AS indices_i
UNWIND indices_i AS i
WITH center, neighbors, i, range(i+1, size(neighbors)-1) AS indices_j
UNWIND indices_j AS j
WITH center, neighbors, neighbors[i] AS n1, neighbors[j] AS n2

// Toggle edge: create if missing, delete if present
OPTIONAL MATCH (n1)-[e:Wire {t:2}]-(n2)
FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN e IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  CREATE (n1)-[:Wire {t:2}]->(n2)
)
WITH center, neighbors, collect(e) AS edges_found
FOREACH (e IN [ex IN edges_found WHERE ex IS NOT NULL] | DELETE e)

// Add center's phase to all neighbors
WITH center, neighbors
FOREACH (n IN neighbors |
  SET n.phase = coalesce(n.phase, 0) - coalesce(center.phase, 0)
)

// Remove the center
DETACH DELETE center

RETURN 1 AS patterns_processed

// Find a boundary pivot candidate
MATCH (z_j:Node {t: 1})-[pivot_edge:Wire {t: 2}]-(z_alpha:Node {t: 1})
MATCH (z_alpha)-[boundary_wire:Wire]-(boundary_node:Node {t: 0})
WHERE z_j.graph_id = $graph_id AND z_alpha.graph_id = $graph_id
  AND z_j.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND toFloat(z_j.phase) = round(toFloat(z_j.phase))

// z_j MUST be interior and have EXACTLY ONE other neighbor (n_j).
MATCH (z_j)-[e_j:Wire]-(n_j:Node)
WHERE n_j <> z_alpha
WITH z_j, z_alpha, boundary_node, boundary_wire, pivot_edge, COLLECT(n_j) AS nj_list, COLLECT(e_j) AS ej_list
WHERE size(nj_list) = 1
  AND nj_list[0].t = 1 AND ej_list[0].t = 2

// z_alpha can only have ONE boundary edge; other neighbors must be Z via Hadamard
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[e_bad_a:Wire]-(n_bad_a:Node)
WHERE n_bad_a <> z_j AND n_bad_a <> boundary_node AND NOT (n_bad_a.t = 1 AND e_bad_a.t = 2)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, boundary_node, boundary_wire, pivot_edge, nj_list, count(e_bad_a) AS bad_a
WHERE bad_a = 0

// Prevent Concurrency Issues
WITH z_j, z_alpha, boundary_node, boundary_wire, pivot_edge, nj_list[0] AS n_j
ORDER BY z_j.id, z_alpha.id, boundary_node.id
LIMIT 1

// Gadgetize z_alpha's phase (Extract it so we can safely pivot)
MATCH (n:Node {graph_id: $graph_id})
WITH z_j, z_alpha, boundary_node, boundary_wire, pivot_edge, n_j, coalesce(max(n.id), -1) AS max_id
        
CREATE (v1:Node {
    t: 1,
    phase: coalesce(toFloat(z_alpha.phase), 0.0),
    graph_id: $graph_id,
    id: max_id + 1,
    qubit: -2,
    row: z_alpha.row
}),
(v2:Node {
    t: 1,
    phase: 0.0,
    graph_id: $graph_id,
    id: max_id + 2,
    qubit: -1,
    row: z_alpha.row
})
CREATE (v1)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(v2)
CREATE (z_alpha)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(v2)
        
// Find N(z_alpha) excluding z_j and boundary_node
WITH z_j, z_alpha, boundary_node, boundary_wire, n_j, v2
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(n_a:Node {t: 1})
WHERE n_a <> z_j
// neighbors_alpha includes original Z-neighbors AND the new v2 gadget center
WITH z_j, z_alpha, boundary_node, boundary_wire, n_j, v2, COLLECT(DISTINCT n_a) + [v2] AS neighbors_alpha

// Update phases (N(z_alpha) gets z_j.phase)
FOREACH (n IN neighbors_alpha |
  SET n.phase = coalesce(toFloat(n.phase), 0.0) + coalesce(toFloat(z_j.phase), 0.0)
)

FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN n_j IN neighbors_alpha THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
  SET n_j.phase = coalesce(toFloat(n_j.phase), 0.0) + 1.0
)

WITH z_j, z_alpha, boundary_node, boundary_wire, n_j, neighbors_alpha,
     CASE coalesce(boundary_wire.t, 1)
       WHEN 1 THEN 2
       WHEN 2 THEN 1
       ELSE 2
     END AS boundary_new_t
        
DELETE boundary_wire
CREATE (boundary_node)-[:Wire {t: boundary_new_t, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(n_j)

// Connect n_j to neighbors_alpha (Toggle H-edges)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, n_j, [x IN neighbors_alpha WHERE x <> n_j] AS pure_neighbors_alpha
        
CALL {
    WITH n_j, pure_neighbors_alpha
    UNWIND pure_neighbors_alpha AS b_node
    OPTIONAL MATCH (n_j)-[e:Wire]-(b_node)
    WITH n_j, b_node, COLLECT(e) AS existing_edges
    WITH n_j, b_node, existing_edges, head([rel IN existing_edges | rel.t]) AS edge_t
    FOREACH (edge IN CASE WHEN edge_t = 2 THEN existing_edges ELSE [] END | DELETE edge)
    FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN edge_t IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      CREATE (n_j)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(b_node)
    )
    FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN edge_t = 1 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET n_j.phase = coalesce(toFloat(n_j.phase), 0.0) + 1.0
    )
    RETURN count(*) AS toggles
}

// REMOVE BOTH z_j and z_alpha to complete the pivot
WITH z_j, z_alpha
DETACH DELETE z_j, z_alpha
        
RETURN 1 AS pivot_operations_performed

// Canonical pivot-gadget rewrite equivalent to
// match_pivot_gadget + pivot_NOT_REWORKED (single match per call).

// Candidate pair: z_j is Pauli, z_alpha is non-Pauli, both interior Z-spiders.
MATCH (z_j:Node {t: 1})-[pivot_edge:Wire {t: 2}]-(z_alpha:Node {t: 1})
WHERE z_j.graph_id = $graph_id AND z_alpha.graph_id = $graph_id
  AND z_j.phase IS NOT NULL AND z_alpha.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND toFloat(z_j.phase) = round(toFloat(z_j.phase))
  AND NOT (toFloat(z_alpha.phase) = 0.0 OR toFloat(z_alpha.phase) = 1.0)
  AND degree(z_alpha) > 1

// Neighbors must be Z-spiders (interior condition in matcher).
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[e_bad_j:Wire]-(n_bad_j:Node)
WHERE n_bad_j <> z_alpha AND n_bad_j.t <> 1
WITH z_j, z_alpha, count(e_bad_j) AS bad_j
WHERE bad_j = 0

OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[e_bad_a:Wire]-(n_bad_a:Node)
WHERE n_bad_a <> z_j AND n_bad_a.t <> 1
WITH z_j, z_alpha, count(e_bad_a) AS bad_a
WHERE bad_a = 0

// z_j may not be connected to a phase-gadget leaf (except through pivot edge).
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire]-(leaf:Node {t: 1})
WHERE leaf <> z_alpha AND degree(leaf) = 1
WITH z_j, z_alpha, count(leaf) AS leaf_count
WHERE leaf_count = 0

// Keep one candidate to avoid overlapping rewrites in one transaction.
WITH z_j, z_alpha
ORDER BY toFloat(z_j.phase) DESC, z_j.id, z_alpha.id
LIMIT 1

// Compute n0, n1, n2 sets from pivot_NOT_REWORKED.
OPTIONAL MATCH (z_j)-[:Wire]-(n_j:Node {t: 1})
WHERE n_j <> z_alpha
WITH z_j, z_alpha, COLLECT(DISTINCT n_j) AS neighbors_j_all

OPTIONAL MATCH (z_alpha)-[:Wire]-(n_a:Node {t: 1})
WHERE n_a <> z_j
WITH z_j, z_alpha, neighbors_j_all, COLLECT(DISTINCT n_a) AS neighbors_alpha_all

WITH z_j, z_alpha,
     [n IN neighbors_j_all WHERE n IN neighbors_alpha_all] AS shared_neighbors,
     [n IN neighbors_j_all WHERE NOT n IN neighbors_alpha_all] AS neighbors_j,
     [n IN neighbors_alpha_all WHERE NOT n IN neighbors_j_all] AS neighbors_alpha,
     coalesce(toFloat(z_j.phase), 0.0) AS zj_phase,
     coalesce(toFloat(z_alpha.phase), 0.0) AS alpha_phase

// Gadgetization pre-step from match_pivot_gadget.
MATCH (n:Node {graph_id: $graph_id})
WITH z_j, z_alpha, neighbors_j, neighbors_alpha, shared_neighbors, zj_phase, alpha_phase,
     coalesce(max(n.id), -1) AS max_id
CREATE (v_gadget:Node {
    t: 1,
    phase: alpha_phase,
    graph_id: $graph_id,
    id: max_id + 1,
    qubit: -2,
    row: z_j.row
})
SET z_j.qubit = -1,
    z_alpha.phase = 0.0
CREATE (z_alpha)-[:Wire {t: 1, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(v_gadget)

// Phase updates from pivot_NOT_REWORKED.
FOREACH (n IN neighbors_alpha |
  SET n.phase = coalesce(toFloat(n.phase), 0.0) + zj_phase
)
FOREACH (n IN shared_neighbors |
  SET n.phase = coalesce(toFloat(n.phase), 0.0) + zj_phase + 1.0
)

// Boundary-like rewiring for m[1][1] = [v_gadget]: move edge from z_alpha to z_j and toggle type.
WITH z_j, z_alpha, v_gadget, neighbors_j, neighbors_alpha, shared_neighbors
MATCH (z_alpha)-[zg:Wire]-(v_gadget)
WITH z_j, z_alpha, v_gadget, neighbors_j, neighbors_alpha, shared_neighbors,
     CASE coalesce(zg.t, 1)
       WHEN 1 THEN 2
       WHEN 2 THEN 1
       ELSE 2
     END AS rewired_t,
     zg
DELETE zg
CREATE (z_j)-[:Wire {t: rewired_t, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(v_gadget)

WITH z_alpha, neighbors_j, neighbors_alpha, shared_neighbors

CALL {
    WITH neighbors_j, neighbors_alpha
    UNWIND neighbors_j AS a_node
    UNWIND neighbors_alpha AS b_node
    WITH a_node, b_node
    WHERE a_node <> b_node
    OPTIONAL MATCH (a_node)-[e:Wire]-(b_node)
    WITH a_node, b_node, COLLECT(e) AS existing_edges
    WITH a_node, b_node, existing_edges, head([rel IN existing_edges | rel.t]) AS edge_t
    FOREACH (edge IN CASE WHEN edge_t = 2 THEN existing_edges ELSE [] END | DELETE edge)
    FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN edge_t IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      CREATE (a_node)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(b_node)
    )
    FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN edge_t = 1 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET a_node.phase = coalesce(toFloat(a_node.phase), 0.0) + 1.0
    )
    RETURN count(*) AS toggles_01
}

CALL {
    WITH neighbors_alpha, shared_neighbors
    UNWIND neighbors_alpha AS a_node
    UNWIND shared_neighbors AS b_node
    WITH a_node, b_node
    WHERE a_node <> b_node
    OPTIONAL MATCH (a_node)-[e:Wire]-(b_node)
    WITH a_node, b_node, COLLECT(e) AS existing_edges
    WITH a_node, b_node, existing_edges, head([rel IN existing_edges | rel.t]) AS edge_t
    FOREACH (edge IN CASE WHEN edge_t = 2 THEN existing_edges ELSE [] END | DELETE edge)
    FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN edge_t IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      CREATE (a_node)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(b_node)
    )
    FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN edge_t = 1 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET a_node.phase = coalesce(toFloat(a_node.phase), 0.0) + 1.0
    )
    RETURN count(*) AS toggles_12
}

CALL {
    WITH neighbors_j, shared_neighbors
    UNWIND neighbors_j AS a_node
    UNWIND shared_neighbors AS b_node
    WITH a_node, b_node
    WHERE a_node <> b_node
    OPTIONAL MATCH (a_node)-[e:Wire]-(b_node)
    WITH a_node, b_node, COLLECT(e) AS existing_edges
    WITH a_node, b_node, existing_edges, head([rel IN existing_edges | rel.t]) AS edge_t
    FOREACH (edge IN CASE WHEN edge_t = 2 THEN existing_edges ELSE [] END | DELETE edge)
    FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN edge_t IS NULL THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      CREATE (a_node)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: $graph_id}]->(b_node)
    )
    FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN edge_t = 1 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
      SET a_node.phase = coalesce(toFloat(a_node.phase), 0.0) + 1.0
    )
    RETURN count(*) AS toggles_02
}

// Remove z_alpha (m[1][0] is empty in pivot_NOT_REWORKED).
WITH z_alpha
DETACH DELETE z_alpha
RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed

MATCH (n)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)--(m)
WITH n, count(m) AS degree
WITH degree, count(*) AS frequency
RETURN degree, frequency
ORDER BY degree;
